Module 1:  Agency, education and innovation (1 hour)

Position of the majority of young [sex of FGD] on the ladder of power and freedom (private rating): 2 = Only a small amount of power and freedom: 3 votes; 1 = Almost no power or freedom to make decisions: 2 votes
Because everyone in the family would want to control a woman, if it’s not the father it must be her brother.
She’s not supposed to raise her voice over her parents specially the father.
If she decides something on her own it’s as if her dignity has dropped and she’s no longer respectful to her father.
It’s a bad thing if she expresses herself, and says all she wants because afterwards she will regret it.
We’re silent because of respect.

The fear is also a factor, if you express more than needed you might be beaten by your parents and your brothers. And sometimes by other elder people of the family for example if the head of the family is your uncle or grandfather, they would intervene as well to “correct” you if you do something wrong.
Our traditions; whatever is said by the father should be respected and done, even in marriage, they chose for you and you only have to accept.
In my case, the teacher used to beat me much, so for me, the school is equal to beating because I was stupid. But now I so much regret why I quitted.

I have a little daughter; and from now my husband decided that she won’t finish school and will quit early, [for most males here, having the daughters or little girls of the family leaving school, is a protection for these girls from harassment and from bad behaviors that girls might learn (like having a boyfriend) therefore, it’s a protection to the family honor] but I will do my best and fight so my daughter gets her education and saves herself.

I left school because of my bad pronunciation, I have a difficulty pronounce properly like a normal person, the teacher used to beat me when I don’t pronounce the right way, and she used to think that’s how she will correct me. It was difficult for her to understand what I say, in the end I hated everything and quitted.
Education enlightens a human’s life; at least one is able to understand the surrounding.

One can travel alone, when the woman is educated she knows which directions to take while an illiterate or someone with a poor level would go astray because they can’t read and also because they can’t tell if someone if fooling them when they ask the way or help to find transport means).
Boys generally leave in middle school, but girls if they start they go until getting high school degree.

That’s because boys want to work at an early age and want to make money while girls think they have nowhere to go, nothing to do, so it’s better to continue studying… many of our village girls go to university and succeed.
The girl is supposed to study and work; she must do something to allow her having a job with the government.
of course the parents are happy and proud with their children studies.
Girls have to leave soon in primary school while boys have the right to continue.

The normal WAS that girls leave school before puberty, nowadays; it’s changing a little bit, because many mothers insist that the girls continue studying, so those who are lucky have this right and go on. As far as boys are concerned, they leave with a free will, because they are lazy and don’t feel like studying.
Families are scared of the girl’s ethics changes in a bad or wrong way and that she becomes a bad girl having too much freedom.
The father is always scared that the girl “opens her eyes” on some things they don’t want her to lean them. But as far as the boy is concerned, they’re not scared of anything to happen to him.
But honestly girls study better than boys and take things seriously.

Quitting school is not a problem of finances it’s a problem of ethics. That’s why the families force girls to quit school even when she’s clever and she’s willing to learn, they have her quit thinking they’re protecting her and protecting their honor!

According to them, the girl should be controlled so she doesn’t do anything wrong. And her mother doesn’t want to assume the responsibility, she doesn’t want to be blamed if something happens, so, she prefers that she stays at home, all they think about is: the girl might be pregnant. And in case it happens, it’s the mother who will be to blame that’s why the mother avoids all the headache and welcomes the idea that the girl stays at home in front of her eyes.
We never work in agriculture accept if they (men) do some small gardens beside the houses…

Reasons for ending education
• The girl sees other people wearing good and expensive clothes, and she wishes to be in the same level but her family can’t afford it, so she feels inferior and leaves
• When the girl grows up she becomes attractive, so, her brother or her father don’t want her to be seen by people often
• Marriage, the house and its work… if someone asks for her hand in marriage, her family “gives” her
• They’re afraid that the girl makes a mistake and gets pregnant and dirties the family’s reputation
• The girl in general thinks she doesn’t have the intellectual level to allow her to study, she thinks she’s stupid
• She doesn’t understand and she’s afraid of others mockery
• The distance from school is too far, and girls are not that strong (healthily) to keep going to school
• Marriage promises (my sister was about to finish her high school degree but when this guy she knows, asked her to leave school and that he would marry her in the summer, she left!) [many agrees]
• The fear of going alone because of the long distance, and having to face forests and rivers
• Some parents can’t afford to buy scholar materials

Two most important reasons
• X – The distance from school is too far, and girls are not that strong (healthily) to keep going to school

Financial situation : schooling needs money, you need to buy books, clothes, pay the transport, pay extra things to the school and most people here don’t afford it, especially when they have 4 or 5 kids all at schooling age. That’s why many give up.
If her family sees her talking to a boy it might be a cause for them to drop her from school.
I wish I studied till I became a teacher or a doctor.
I didn’t have any goals; I wanted a man and got him.
I wish I had a stable job if I had the chance to study.

I have a pronunciation problem, but I wish I studied and became a doctor… if had a surgery when I was young I could have avoided people’s mockery and I could have studied. [this girl has a special condition, something like cleft palate but it’s not external and it doesn’t allow her to pronounce properly, we barely could understand what she was saying, and because of her condition she left school though she was clever according to her sister and to her –reporting she learns fast and she enjoys it- and the mockery not only came from her classmates, the teacher used to yell at her and ask her to make speak clearly!]

If I had the chance to study I would have been dangerous; “I would pierce the eyes” like a bird’s beak , [it is a Moroccan way to say someone is sharp] but unfortunately we had no school in the village when I was a little child.
The girl has two directions normally: it’s either getting married or staying at home (the parents’)
They should do something to help them make some money like working in crafts making, sewing or as hairdressers.

The woman here cleans the stable (here they don’t let her go out)
Young girls don’t work things related to livestock; they refuse completely
I’m different, I can feed a cow and observe her health and tell if she’s sick, bloated, trembling or anything.
I did help with harvesting winter chickpeas, it’s done manually and most women do it.
There are girls who help with harvesting wheat with sickles, but usually it’s the women and men (adults).
This new wheat is nice, it makes good bread.
I think it gives a bigger amount of produce than previous varieties.
Here we learn new practices regarding livestock only and that’s when a woman is married, usually it is cows and sheep.
We ask about the food and the medicine for livestock.
We treat lands Wheat and potato.
Important for women:
The harvesting machine: it saved women from the hard work of the sickle.
The new wheat variety: it is important because it gives good bread, women like to make a good quality bread.
Important for men:

The drip irrigation is important to men because it gives a lot of produce and it doesn’t need hard work like old irrigation and the water is there from wells. The government helps digging wells when you apply drip irrigation.
The tractor: it is important because plowing is the main activity for men.
We can learn sewing, embroideries and hairdressing or anything feminine but the agricultural work is for men…and women have nothing to do with it.
Here, it’s a shame if a woman interferes with agriculture, it’s like she deletes the existence of men!
The woman might contribute in a slight way in agricultural activities, she only does the light work and prepared food for the men who work.

a drop in produces compared to 10 years ago.

They do follow the man in all agricultural practices; because everyone thinks the woman doesn’t deserve to be followed… she doesn’t know anything!
Men, there’s nobody to stop them from doing what they want.

All parents wish to see their sons moving.
If we were brother and sister, the parents won’t allow us… if we’re not, then we won’t know what to do and how to do things at all, we don’t have the knowledge.
And even in case we learn, we won’t be allowed to go to the market, the presence of a male is necessary.
Boys- of course- can decide, but girls, there are no girls who decide.

When women own plots, it’s usually a man of the family or a worker who would suggest what to do about it, and suggestion here is with a big percentage of decision making, the woman just needs to confirm.

Both the man and the women should work on the land… but I don’t know anything at all, how can I work? [it was an answer among others, she thinks the woman is supposed to be helping the man but she’s giving an example about herself knowing nothing. For her, the fact that doesn’t make it happen is the ignorance of the woman not the physical weakness]
No he would take care of everything, and even for the money, he can give her some only if he wants.

My husband wouldn’t allow me to work on my land. [she has a land that she inherited, but always, it’s the man who work on plots, either it’s wives’ or their own plot, no difference, and agriculture labor is for men not women]
When I finish the house work I would help him if I have a spare time.
“kif-kif” it’s the same… equally, there’s no difference.

If there are kids, I should take care of my kids as a priority, I won’t be obliged to help him. [this refers to financial help, because for this community and most communities in Morocco; the woman only works if her husband’s income is not enough for living].

Yes, that’s the ignorance and the lack of awareness.
It’s necessary that they consult about everything since they are partners., they decide jointly.
